content.text: When you first authenticate Claude Code with your Claude Console account, a workspace called “Claude Code” is automatically created for you. This workspace provides centralized cost tracking and management for all Claude Code usage in your organization.
You can have both account types under the same email address. If you need to log in again or switch accounts, use the `/login` command within Claude Code.

content.text: Claude Code reads your files as needed - you don’t have to manually add context. Claude also has access to its own documentation and can answer questions about its features and capabilities.

content.text: Claude Code always asks for permission before modifying files. You can approve individual changes or enable “Accept all” mode for a session.
